name: 01 · Modern Sass overview
focus: Module aliases, map keys, named arguments, nested properties and interpolated selectors. Compare @content(…), using ($accent), border: 1px solid { … }, &:nth-child(n + 2) and .#{$name}\:hidden: simeonoff/tree-sitter-scss reports ERROR nodes while P233/tree-sitter-scss parses them.

name: 02 · Basic CSS
focus: Selector punctuation, ordinary values, units, colors, and pseudo-elements.

name: 03 · Variables, flags & maps
focus: !default / !global flags, booleans, null, nested map keys, and namespaced variable writes.

name: 04 · Modules & configuration
focus: @forward filters and prefixes, with-clause keys, wildcard modules, and module-qualified includes. External modules are illustrative.

name: 05 · Mixins, rest args & content
focus: Rest parameters, argument expansion, @content arguments, using bindings, and named argument boundaries.

name: 06 · Functions & control flow
focus: @for to / through, @else if, @each destructuring, comparison operators, and interpolated generated classes.

name: 07 · Interpolation & strings
focus: Interpolation inside strings, properties, selectors, URLs, and comments; nested string captures.

name: 08 · Selectors & namespaces
focus: Descendant boundaries, attribute operators, case modifiers, selector-list pseudos, nth-child of, and namespace prefixes.

name: 09 · Nested properties & rules
focus: Font: / border: property groups versus nested selectors, plus placeholder and @extend captures.

name: 10 · Media, supports & containers
focus: Range comparisons, boolean query operators, selector() tests, style() queries, and custom property names.

name: 11 · Raw values & custom properties
focus: Raw $ text versus interpolated Sass, balanced payloads, empty var() fallbacks, and unquoted URLs containing //.

name: 12 · Modern CSS at-rules
13 · Numbers, math & keyframes
focus: Number / unit boundaries, exponents, slash separators, custom properties, and keyframe selector roles.

name: 14 · Escapes & Unicode boundaries
focus: Compare $紫色, .卡片, .caf\e9 and #item\:one: simeonoff/tree-sitter-scss reports ERROR nodes while P233/tree-sitter-scss preserves their roles. Rarer .a\}b, .\31 23 and .颜色😀 also test escape extents and offsets after emoji.

name: 15 · Hash values in control flow
focus: Compare @each … #abc, #def: simeonoff/tree-sitter-scss and the official grammar report an ERROR while P233/tree-sitter-scss parses the list cleanly. @if #abc is a nearby control that all three parse.

name: 16 · Known limits
focus: Valid code that P233/tree-sitter-scss still gets wrong, as its README and ARCHITECTURE record: a comment before a quoted url() argument, a typed attr() union and an escape inside An+B. On line 4 it also colors the URL's https scheme apart from the rest. simeonoff/tree-sitter-scss parses the url() comment and the typed attr(); the official grammar parses the url() comment.
